name: context overview
wording: An account of one bounded context computed from the concept journal, never written by hand, read first at every reconstitution: its subject and place in the context map, then its concepts in plain prose, each whole before its parts and otherwise in the order recorded, with any cycle named, then its open decisions, so a session meets the design whole before its parts.
reason: The operator: retire the ledger. The journal records the design and knows nothing of the work, so an overview carries the design alone.
